scope: synthetic sampler role-isolation audit; no prediction-quality claim

fixture.ordering: entity then decision time; each immutable partition contains all three roles
fixture.perturbation: change only test-role feature values and target values; keep IDs, decision/dependency times, validation and all training rows fixed
fixture.required_geometry: same partition count, row counts, and temporal bounds in both snapshots

comparisons: training example ID order from the legacy content-pin sampler
train-only normalization and empirical baseline statistics
final model weight tensors, excluding artifact/snapshot pins

acceptance.legacy_audit: test-only payload perturbation changes training order and final weights while train/validation rows, statistics, and partition geometry remain unchanged
acceptance.remediation: an opt-in versioned sampler must make training order and final weights invariant to the same test-only perturbation
acceptance.resume: the versioned sampler must reproduce uninterrupted weights after an interruption

decision_rule: No model tuning or prediction scoring. Preserve the legacy result, then verify the opt-in sampler against the same role-isolation invariant. Keep the legacy sampler available for compatibility.
limitations: The fixture tests only training-order dependence on nontraining payload bytes.
The guarantee is conditional on unchanged role membership, row IDs, ordering, partition geometry, and recipe.
No market, generalization, calibration, or production claim follows.
